test_title: PYST 39: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

A $ B means ‘A is the mother of B’,

A + B means ‘A is the brother of B’,

A @ B means ‘A is the wife of B’,

and A ÷ B means ‘A is the father of B’.

How is E related to N if ‘E $ F @ G ÷ M + N’?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 $ 
 +
 @
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Brother
 Wife
 Father
 
 

 

Given: E $ F @ G ÷ M + N

It means:

E is the Mother of F.

F is the Wife of G.

G is the Father of M.

M is the Brother of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a600dbef148ec4e6a48196f7cea58fcaead2794f61600e627a7f5237e6ecc4ec.png] 

So, E is the **'Mother's mother' **of N.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
